facts_of_case: Wife's appeal against the judgment of Additional District Judge, Barnala, dated 22.10.1991, who had allowed the petition filed by her husband for dissolution of marriage and granted a decree of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that there has been no resumption of cohabitation for a period of more than one year.
legal_principles.held: It was under the circumstances that the respondent filed a petition for dissolution of marriage by a decree of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: A party's failure to resume cohabitation after a decree for restitution of conjugal rights can be considered in determining the grounds for divorce.
legal_principles.held: The appellant had failed to resume cohabitation even after the passing of decree for restitution of conjugal rights for a period of more than one year before the filing of the petition.

outcome.final_order: A decree for divorce was granted to the husband.
